name: Nagakura Mato
source:
Upperclassman. Member of the (boob) Archery Club. The only daughter of a prestigious tea ceremony family, the Nagakura School, she's an old-fashioned young lady.

Raised in a sheltered environment, she has a serious and gentle personality. She's demure. However, perhaps due to her somewhat airheaded nature, she can be a bit too laid-back?

She's not exactly shy around people, but she lacks immunity to men. For the protagonist, he seems to be the only guy her age she can talk to easily.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=827979&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
